an1.1:1.1: Namo tassa bhagavato arahato sammā sambuddhassa. 1. Evaṃ me sutaṃ.
an1.1:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
an1.1:1.5: Bhadante ti te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosum.
an1.1:2.1: Nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekarūpam pi samanupassāmi yaṃ evaṃ purisassa cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati yathayidaṃ bhikkhave itthirūpaṃ.
an1.1:2.2: Itthirūpaṃ bhikkhave purisassa cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatī

an1.2:1.2: Itthisaddo bhikkhave purisassa cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatī
